brief:
Israeli forces struck a tent sheltering displaced Palestinians west of Gaza City on Thursday evening, wounding several people, the Wafa news agency reported. The strike occurred as Gaza's humanitarian crisis deepens amid displacement of large civilian populations.

Details of the casualties and damage were not immediately available. The attack adds to a pattern of strikes across Gaza affecting civilians in makeshift shelters and crowded displacement camps.
dek: Several people wounded in Israeli strike on tent sheltering displaced Gazans, Wafa reports Several displaced Gazans were injuries on Thursday evening following an Israeli strike west of Gaza City, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli strike wounds displaced Gazans in tent camp west of Gaza City
